__doc__: Supplier-specific selector rules.  One array per supplier; first match
wins.  Each rule has a `when` predicate and a `canonical` name.  All
predicate keys are optional AND-combined — a rule fires only when every
key in `when` matches.  See docs/BACKEND_HANDOFF.md § 4 for the full key
list.  Keep the comments-as-notes near each rule so future edits know
which real portal element the rule targets.
